source_title: NASDAQ: AUR Investigation Alert: Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, LLP Encourages Aurora Innovation, Inc. (AUR) Investors to Contact the Firm
source_excerpt:
RADNOR, Pa. , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, LLP ( www.ktmc.com ), a nationally recognized securities litigation law firm, is investigating potential violations of the federal securities laws by Aurora Innovation, Inc. ("Aurora Innovation") ( NASDAQ: AUR ) on behalf of investors who purchased or acquired Aurora Innovation securities and experienced significant financial losses.
Aurora Innovation Reports Production Delays On October 28, 2026, after the market closed, Aurora Innovation reported its third quarter 2026 financial results and revealed, among other things, that supply chain bottlenecks delayed the company's driverless truck targets. Specifically, Aurora Innovation disclosed that the company encountered unexpected production delays for its autonomous commercial trucks that will push back its commercial targets by roughly six weeks to two months. As a result, Aurora Innovation slashed its full-year 2026 revenue guidance.
Aurora Innovation's Stock Drops Over 13% Following the news of Aurora Innovation's production delays and slashed guidance, the company's stock price fell over 13%.
Investors who purchased Aurora Innovation, Inc. (NASDAQ: AUR ) securities and experienced losses may have legal rights under the federal securities laws.
CONTACT KTMC TO DISCUSS YOUR LEGAL RIGHTS: If you purchased or acquired Aurora Innovation, Inc. securities and have lost money on your investment, please provide your information here: https://www.ktmc.com/aur-aurora-innovation-inc-investigation?utm_campaign=hc?utm_source=PR_Newswire&utm_medium=pressrelease&utm_campaign=aur&mktm=PR
There is no cost or obligation to speak with an attorney.
